entries.title: Scorn
entries.definitive_edition: Scorn Deluxe Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release and current patch; no console emulation route is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 4 PC presentation with PC settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC Deluxe route is the best version because it keeps the highest capture/settings flexibility while also covering the Deluxe extras: official soundtrack and digital artbook. The PS5 Deluxe physical release has collectible packaging, but no sourced gameplay content that is absent from PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Scorn on Steam/Epic or a PC Deluxe key that includes the soundtrack and digital artbook, then play the Windows PC build. Check for shader-compilation and update notes before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: No separate remaster is documented; later updates fixed notable PC shader-compilation issues.
